_note: Full scan of 2026-09-27 (night of 26 to 27 September, Israel time), asked for by the owner: every product's photos were compared with its title and description, all 1,227 products (1,098 imported before, 128 from wave 1 and the demo product). 55 were flagged and every flag was checked against the supplier's album (Yupoo). Results: 47 titles fixed (the same text in the description's first line and in the photo alt text; tags re-derived with scripts/catalog/classify.mjs and catalog/classification.json), 4 photo problems fixed, 4 titles confirmed correct from back photos in the album (those backs were added to the products). Nothing else changed: price, stock, status, handle and channels are as before. These products have no en/ar translations yet (task: translations for the older products).
